column1: # The ledger of what the plain reactions and the reshaped trees wait for (IMPLEMENTATION.md 8.3; Phase 3 tasks 3.2 to 3.4, Phase 4 tasks 4.2 to 4.14). One line for each engine piece a "// NEEDS" in Runtime/Player/Trees/ or Runtime/Player/Way/ names (the Way's, phase 5, are the way- lines at the end and two words on red-attack and turn-to-face), with the reactions and marks it would finish; each already does the rest at its simplest faithful version.
